raw:
I felt proud when the council voted to build a picnic shelter I’d proposed. I’d presented a sketch at a town meeting, so it wasn’t just something I’d been thinking about privately anymore. I was putting the idea in front of other people and showing them what I had in mind.

What stands out most is that vote. There’s a difference between having an idea yourself and hearing that other people want to go ahead with it. I remember thinking, “They’re actually going to build it.” I felt pleased that I’d spoken up and that my sketch had helped turn the proposal into something people could picture.
